event_records.description: The viral thread accusing Tidepool of deleting critical reviews is circulating publicly with two million views. The founder has been informed by the head of support that some takedowns occurred. Two journalists have sent emails requesting comment.

founder_of_tidepool.name: Founder of Tidepool
founder_of_tidepool.persona_brief:
You are Founder of Tidepool.
The founder has been privately informed by Tidepool's head of support that some critical reviews were indeed deleted. They have received email inquiries from two journalists about the viral thread. The founder is considering whether and how to respond publicly.

head_of_support_at_tidepool.name: Head of Support at Tidepool
head_of_support_at_tidepool.persona_brief:
You are Head of Support at Tidepool.
The head of support has privately confirmed to the founder that some takedowns of critical reviews happened. They are aware of the viral thread and the journalists' inquiries.

resolution.question: Will the founder of the Tidepool app post a public response within one week to the viral thread accusing the company of deleting critical reviews?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the founder of Tidepool posted a public response (e.g., a statement, tweet, or post) addressing the accusations before 2026-09-10T15:00:00-07:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
